title: Rule of Two and agent guardrails
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for enforcing monotone Rule of Two capability lattices across multi-step tool DAGs, bidirectional typed privacy placeholder vaults and model license-tier routing firewalls.
boundaries: RuleOfTwoCapabilityLattice deterministically refuses with status 403 and a minimal witness path whenever local or transitive DAG taint combines untrusted_input, sensitive_access and external_mutation_or_egress without a scoped human_steward_approval token.
BidirectionalPrivacyPlaceholderGateway vaults sensitive entities into typed <ENTITY_TYPE_NNN> placeholders while preserving 64-character SHA-256 digests and coreference across turns.
All leg ceilings, placeholder index widths, DAG bounds and license-tier matrices resolve from default_grid_spec.json and pass ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate.
Importing the pack writes nothing, enqueues nothing and installs no code.

nouns.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for enforcing monotone Rule of Two capability lattices across multi-step tool DAGs, bidirectional typed privacy placeholder vaults and model license-tier routing firewalls

value.lets_workers: Track monotone capability taint across multi-step tool DAGs so unapproved combinations of untrusted_input, sensitive_access and external_mutation_or_egress fail closed with 403 and a minimal witness path, scrub sensitive entities into lossless <ENTITY_TYPE_001> placeholder vaults and route payloads across contributor_training_allowed, standard_zero_retention and local_open_weights license tiers.

flow.when: Propagate monotone capability taint across a proposed multi-step tool DAG and block unapproved three-leg combinations before execution.
Vault outbound sensitive tokens into deterministic <ENTITY_TYPE_NNN> placeholders, route payloads across model license tiers and rehydrate inbound responses.
Independently audit 403 witness minimality, 100% outbound zero-leak recall, exact round-trip rehydration and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate conformance.

value.worked_example: Synthetic 2-leg allow DAG, 5-node diamond 3-leg refusal DAG (403 with minimal witness path excluding distractor nodes), steward-approved override (200), bidirectional placeholder vaulting (1.0 zero-leak recall and 1.0 round-trip fidelity) and 3-tier license firewall routing recomputed in test_rule_of_two_guardrails.py.

nouns.title: Guardrail: unapproved transitive combinations of untrusted input, sensitive access and external mutation or egress fail closed with 403
nouns.category_reason: Prevents prompt-injected exfiltration or unauthorized external state changes across multi-step tool chains.

value.rule: RuleOfTwoCapabilityLattice permits at most two capability legs across any topological tool path unless a human_steward_approval token explicitly authorizes the violating step, returning status 403 and the minimal ancestor witness subgraph otherwise.
value.how_it_is_checked: RuleOfTwoCapabilityLattice.evaluate_dag computes monotone set-union taint across upstream parents and rejects agent-forged or missing steward approvals.

nouns.title: Guardrail: sensitive entities require reversible typed placeholders and license-compatible retention tiers without inline magic numbers
nouns.category_reason: Prevents raw PII/credential leakage to training-enabled APIs while keeping operational bounds externalized in default_grid_spec.json.

value.rule: BidirectionalPrivacyPlaceholderGateway replaces sensitive entities with coreference-preserving <ENTITY_TYPE_NNN> placeholders while leaving SHA-256 hex digests intact, ModelLicenseTierFirewall blocks non-public or restricted-license payloads from contributor training tiers and ZeroHardcodedValuesAstGate rejects inline magic literals.
value.how_it_is_checked: test_rule_of_two_guardrails.py verifies 1.0 outbound zero-leak recall, 1.0 inbound round-trip fidelity, strict 3-tier license routing and zero AST magic-literal violations.

nouns.category_reason: Zero-model procedure evaluating DAG capability combinations, placeholder vaults and model license tiers.

value.taint_propagation: effective_legs(step) = own_legs(step) union_{parent in depends_on} effective_legs(parent)

verbs.title: Evaluate monotone Rule of Two capability taint across a proposed multi-step tool DAG

slots.name: dag_bundle
slots.description: Pin of candidate tool DAG steps and optional human steward approval metadata.

steps: Resolve max_unapproved_legs and status codes from default_grid_spec.json via NodeGrid.
Order tool steps topologically, compute monotone taint unions and return 403 plus minimal witness path whenever three legs combine without a scoped human_steward_approval token.

acceptance.check: Any unapproved combination of all three capability legs returns status 403 and excludes unrelated distractor DAG nodes from minimal_witness_path.

verbs.title: Scrub outbound payloads into typed privacy placeholders and route across model license tiers
verbs.summary: Replace sensitive entities with coreference-preserving <ENTITY_TYPE_001> tokens, route payloads across contributor_training_allowed, standard_zero_retention and local_open_weights tiers and rehydrate inbound responses.
verbs.outcome: Placeholder-vaulted payload, license-tier routing decision and round-trip rehydration check.

slots.name: payload_bundle
slots.description: Pin of outbound payload, sensitivity metadata and license tags.

steps: Vault sensitive entities into <ENTITY_TYPE_NNN> placeholders while preserving 64-character hexadecimal content digests.
Evaluate sensitivity, synthetic provenance and license tags with ModelLicenseTierFirewall and verify lossless inbound rehydration.

acceptance.check: Outbound scrubbed payloads retain zero ground-truth secrets, rehydrate losslessly and block secret or local-only licenses from remote tiers.
